dataset_role: Kozlowski et al. (2025) public reactor-observation export
analysis_population: 10 qc_include=True substrate reactors across 4 treatments, 3 inoculum blanks
validation_task: Nested whole-reactor holdout: train on sibling reactors of the same treatment restricted to time_days <= cutoff, predict the held-out reactor for time_days in (cutoff, 21]. Not unseen-study, unseen-material, or dose-response transfer.
decision_rule_margin_note: Prespecified practical threshold given in the task brief, not a value derived from known measurement error.
bootstrap_note: Conditional, unstable interval: only 2-3 reactors retained per treatment, so whole-reactor bootstrap resampling has very few distinct values to draw from within some treatments.
